#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

class TrainSolver {
private:
    int n, m, s;
    long long t;

    void step() {
        int curJump = (int)(t-- % n);
        int direction = (s < m) ? 1 : -1;
        s += direction * curJump;
        s %= n;
        if (s < 0) s += n;
    }

    void fullLoop() {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) step();
    }

public:
    void solve() {
        // Read input line and handle commas
        string line;
        getline(cin, line);
        // Replace commas with spaces
        for (char &c : line) if (c == ',') c = ' ';
        stringstream ss(line);
        ss >> n >> m >> s >> t;
        s--; // convert to 0-indexed

        while ((t % n) != 0) step();

        vector<long long> lastSeen(n, -1);
        while (t != 0) {
            fullLoop();
            if (lastSeen[s] != -1) {
                long long interval = lastSeen[s] - t;
                t %= interval;
                break;
            } else {
                lastSeen[s] = t;
            }
        }
        while (t != 0) step();
        cout << (s + 1) << '\n';
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    TrainSolver solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
